I may never see the sun again =(
Great game, I feel that you will enjoy it more if you have a friend play it with you. It is more enjoyable with a team mate.

The game is very well put together in terms of how you actually complete the missions. If you wanna go in guns blazing, you can do so. Or if you and your 3 Tenno Compadres want to go splinter cell with it you can do that too. 

The graphics are equally amazing and the scenery and actual instances are very cool to explore during missions.

The music is very awesome as well and gets me pumped unlike most mmo's where I have to put on music thats on my hard drive so that im still in it to fight the whole way and not get bored. 

Matchmaking takes a bit but this could be because im so far behind the loop now (I started playing it off and on when it got to steam and I think I am level 14 now or something) 

Bottom line is there is something about this game that I can't put a finger on that keeps me coming back.

If you value your freedom, you should probably look elsewhere...

First of all, the "Free To Play" aspect of this game is just that. There are no "Pay To Win" items. The only thing your money can buy you is aesthetic features and the ability to save some time from farming various things. However, I find most of the enjoyability of this game derives from gathering said materials and resources.

I cannot stress how important it is to be able to use teamwork to get into certain areas of the game though. The various warframes have the ability to compliment other warframes and will make quick work of any challenge. There is a fairly helpful community within Warframe as well which gives the game a good tone.

It also helps to mention that the game carries over console controls if you are using a controller however I find you lose a good portion of precision not using your mouse and keyboard...boils down to preference though, I suppose.

Overall, this is a no-brainer. Free to download; free to play. No risk. Can't pass this game up.

...unless you enjoy life outdoors in your free time, that is.
